display.purpose: Hero headline only, Cormorant Garamond 600, lining figures.

label.purpose: Table column headings, phone-card cell labels, ring caption.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Hero portal card, popovers, toasts, the admission letter sheet.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrance rise (0.7s), arrow nudge, indent on portal links, press scale.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour changes on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single gold action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gold-500, #c9a75a); color: var(--navy-950, #060d1f); font: 600 15px/1.1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-300, #e3c98a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3c98a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside the gold button.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.28); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #f5f0e6; font: 600 15px/1.1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(201,167,90,0.1); border-color: #c9a75a; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3c98a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Student Number Field
components.description: Midnight-filled input with hairline gold border and gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 46px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.28); border-radius: 6px; background: #060d1f; color: #f5f0e6; font: inherit; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.04em; caret-color: #e3c98a; transition: border-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8c97ae; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #c9a75a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3c98a; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #e3c98a; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Muted header link; current page in pale gold with a brass underline.
components.html: PlacesAdmissions
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; height: 72px; background: #0a1630; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.28); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; color: #a9b4cc; font: 500 15px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.16s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f5f0e6; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] { color: #e3c98a; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page]::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: #c9a75a; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3c98a; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Tinted pill with a leading dot; tone set by a variable.
components.css: .ds-badge { --tone: #5cc29a; --tone-bg: rgba(92,194,154,0.14); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 3px 12px 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--tone-bg); color: var(--tone); font: 600 12.5px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Registration Card
components.description: Signature double-ruled card used for the Admissions Portal and the reservation.
components.html:
Admissions Portal

Enter your student number to begin.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; padding: 36px; background: #0f2247; color: #f5f0e6; border: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.28); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); font: 15px/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.14); border-radius: 11px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 2rem/1.08 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #a9b4cc; }

components.name: Portal Link Row
components.description: Ruled editorial row with a brass chevron, used instead of icon cards.
components.html: Browse and applySee open places
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 6px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.28); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.28); color: #f5f0e6; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.16s ease, padding 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-row span { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-row strong { font: 600 17px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row small { color: #a9b4cc; font: 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row svg { color: #c9a75a; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(201,167,90,0.07); padding-left: 12px; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3c98a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Countdown Ring
components.description: Hold timer: brass progress ring with lining tabular numerals; turns amber when urgent.
components.html: 09:42Remaining
components.css: .ds-ring { position: relative; width: 212px; height: 212px; } .ds-ring svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-ring-track { fill: none; stroke: rgba(245,240,230,0.1); stroke-width: 3.3; } .ds-ring-value { fill: none; stroke: #c9a75a; stroke-width: 3.3; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-ring-center { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #f5f0e6; } .ds-count { font: 600 2.7rem/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-cap { color: #a9b4cc; font: 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Ruled Table
components.description: Hairline-ruled places table with tracked muted headings and tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { border: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.28); border-radius: 12px; background: #0a1630; overflow: hidden; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #f5f0e6; font: 15px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-table thead th { padding: 14px 16px; text-align: left; background: #0f2247; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.28); color: #a9b4cc; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-table tbody th, .ds-table tbody td { padding: 16px; text-align: left; border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,167,90,0.14); } .ds-table tbody th { font: 600 1.35rem/1.15 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums; } .ds-table .n { text-align: right; } .ds-table tbody tr:first-child th, .ds-table tbody tr:first-child td { border-top: 0; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(201,167,90,0.05); }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a prestigious boarding school's admissions office after dark: a deep navy ground, one gold used for action, hairlines and the crest, and ivory serif headings. The working admission tool is not hidden behind marketing; it sits on the letterhead, as the double-ruled registration card in the first viewport.

Density is calm and editorial. Sections are ruled lists, timelines and ruled tables rather than grids of boxed cards. Public pages (Home) may be expressive; operating pages (places board, reservation, my applications, Registrar) trade expression for clarity because the guardian is working against a hold timer.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only (color-scheme: dark); depth comes from stepping through five navy tones plus gold hairlines.
One gold. Gold marks the action, the rules, the crest and the current state; nothing else is saturated except the four tinted states.
Cormorant Garamond for headings and numerals, Inter for everything that is read or operated.
Thin gold hairlines (28% and 14% alpha) separate content instead of boxes and fills.
Drawn inline SVG for crest and icons; no image files, glyph icons or icon fonts.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: There is a single gold family. A second accent hue is not introduced; new emphasis uses ivory, muted, or a hairline.

rules.name: The Tint, Never Fill Rule
rules.body: State colours are a 14-16% tinted ground with the full colour only on text, dot, or border. A bright solid state fill does not appear.

rules.name: The Paper Exception
rules.body: The admission letter is a white sheet with near-black text (it is a printable document). It is the only light surface.

rules.name: The Lining Figures Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: lining-nums is set on body; any element using the font: shorthand must re-declare it, and data columns add tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks Rule
rules.body: Cormorant is for headings, numerals and mottos (gold italic). Inter carries every control, label and paragraph.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a gold hairline before a shadow or a fill. Shadows are reserved for surfaces that float above the page.

dos: Do build new surfaces from the variables in tokens.css; components only consume tokens.
Do separate content with gold hairlines (--line for structure, --line-soft for inner dividers) before reaching for a box or shadow.
Do use brass gold for the single primary action per view and pale gold for links, focus and numerals.
Do keep the visible 2px pale-gold focus ring, themed selection, caret and scrollbars.
Do force lining, tabular figures on any number a guardian must read, and re-declare lining-nums after any font: shorthand on a serif element.
Do present lists as ruled editorial rows; turn tables into stacked labelled cards under 640px.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion (animations and transitions collapse to near zero).
Do draw icons as inline SVG in gold-500 or a state colour.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue or a bright solid state fill; states are tints.
Don't use thick coloured side borders on cards, strips or notices.
Don't use glyph or emoji icons, or icon fonts.
Don't put the serif on controls, or Inter on headings and mottos.
Don't use a row of identical icon cards to describe features.
Don't put a light surface on the page other than the printable admission letter.
Don't put gradient text or heavy shadows on content cards; the hero's faint gold glow and diagonal hairline texture are the only gradients.
